name: Re:Zero kara Hajimeru Choukyou Seikatsu ~Saimin Choukyou Rem~
original_name: RE:ゼロから始める調教生活～催眠調教レム～
source:
Defeated by Petelgeuse, Rem's memories are altered by the power of the "Unseen Hand", which makes one of the Witch Cultists appear to Rem as "Natsuki Subaru".

The fake Subaru's job, given by Petelgeuse, is to train Rem to become a sex slave of the Witch Cult within 5 days.

[Edited from [url=https://hbox.jp/category/doujin/doujin/=/cid/550269]HBOX.JP[/url]]
translation:
败于培提尔其乌斯之手后，雷姆的记忆在“不可视之手”的力量下遭到篡改，竟将其中一名魔女教徒错认成了“菜月昴”。

而培提尔其乌斯交给这个冒牌昴的任务，便是在5天之内将雷姆彻底调教成效忠魔女教的性奴隶。

[摘自[url=https://hbox.jp/category/doujin/doujin/=/cid/550269]HBOX.JP[/url]（经编辑）]
